methods.native_figures: Unchanged saved native distances and frozen thresholds; lower is better.
methods.scalar_figure: Saved distances, not physical means; rows are explicit defined subpopulations. Color is log2(distance/A) with range [-1,6]; text is untruncated 4-significant-digit display.
methods.trajectories: Same saved fields; raw values plus 50-update trailing arithmetic means; gradient log axis; R is unweighted.
methods.uncertainty: One training seed and one evaluation MC bank per run; no independent replicate error bars.
methods.missing_DEV_G0: Not saved in either run; not recomputed or imputed.

visual_QA.method: Actual PNGs displayed via view_image; final scalar revision displayed again.
checks: Titles, legends, axes, bar values and saved field labels are readable.
Final scalar colorbar and footnotes do not overlap.
All three hypotheses and both splits are shown.
Missing DEV G0 is explicit; single MC bank and previously exposed DEV are explicit.
Full negative training data estimates and full PSD_raw numerical values are retained.
Relative-to-A colors do not imply acceptance; historical negative decisions are retained.

derived_rate_example.display: 14.994 percentage points is the absolute fake-real rate difference, not the fake rate.
